description: Find broken links on a public web page (or in supplied HTML, e.g. a draft before publishing): fetches the page (SSRF-safe), extracts links (optionally images / scripts / stylesheets too), then checks up to 50 of them in parallel with HEAD (falling back to GET), every target re-validated against private / internal addresses and pinned to its checked IP. Reports status, category (ok / redirect / broken / error / blocked), redirect location, response time and anchor text, broken first. Price: $0.006 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/link-check

assets.description: Also check img / script / stylesheet / iframe URLs

base.description: Base URL for relative links in inline html
